body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule (bound anchor elsewhere invalidates ANY giver answer incl. cell targets).
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has (build/install/refuel).
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**: every order reads as base game — replace disabled vanilla row, inherit orderInPriority + target icon, Default priority. Lore saved (ui).
- **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**: every arrival continuation self-heals (bring-and-X payload+retry; generic ABPendingOrders idle-gated 18t retry; think-node routers re-run; JobDrivers self-contained).
- **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD (2026-07-23)**: while locked, ALL automatic level switches are blocked at the Game.CurrentMap setter — stairs ride-along AND selection/jump-to a pawn on another level (bar/alert/letter). Pawn still selects; view stays. Manual switches (widget/hotkey/gizmo, all via JumpPreservingView) set LevelCamera.ManualSwitch to bypass; cross-level order machinery writes currentMapIndex directly so it is unaffected. Column-scoped (jumping to another colony still works).
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art; risers host atlases. Climb animations vanilla pipeline. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).

## 2026-07-23 LATEST (compile green, needs relaunch)
- **Level-lock click fix (user: clicking a pawn while locked still changes level)**: root cause was Selector.SelectInternal (and CameraJumper) switching Current.Game.CurrentMap on any cross-map selection. Fix: prefix the Game.CurrentMap setter — LevelCamera.ShouldSuppressJump blocks the switch when locked + not-manual + target is another level of the same column. New LevelLockJumpPatches.cs + ManualSwitch bracket on JumpPreservingView.
- **Deep compat + seamless scan**: generic ABPendingOrders idle-gated retry (all routed orders continue after stairs); haul option priority High->Default; full compat-module vanilla-when-alone table in the audit doc (all inert without host, all order surfaces native or self-contained).
- **Art tuner copy/paste**; **refuel continuation self-heal** + **native float-menu styling** (AddNative).

## PARITY BATCH (P1+P2, 2026-07-23) — BUILT, verification rolling
Trade beacons column-wide; refuel/vat demand + forced order; transporter manifests; surgery-bill ingredients; baby food; mech recharge routing; gear probes (apparel/weapon/drugs); non-Ideo gatherings; detectors roof/childcare/mech-repair. P3 excluded by design (Anomaly, anima, turrets).

## EARLIER 2026-07-23 (verification rolling)
Install/uninstall parity + auto ferry; robot bounce fix (probe-gated) + #70 dock fix + #72 StationElsewhere; container-storage push fix; fence patch; Achtung drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver + bring-and-build; jobs settings tab; biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. Forced cross-level refuel USER-VERIFIED; Robots++ crossing verified.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab: presets + cadence sliders + 5 flow checkboxes.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art (+copy/paste; bake fold-in pending).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified crossing; probe-gated + StationElsewhere). Achtung! drags (soft). Reverse Commands (column colonists, self-heal). Giddy-up / Vehicle Framework (routing exclusions). Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (UI, fail-open). All inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: camera level lock upgraded to hard (blocks selection-driven level changes at the CurrentMap setter) on top of the deep compat/seamless pass + full P1+P2 parity batch. Compile green — relaunch owed: lock-while-clicking, generalized continuation, and the parity circuit. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
